instructions.question: Does the tweet lean positive or negative in feeling, or does it have no noticeable lean (neutral)?
instructions.rule: If the author shows a noticeable personal lean, choose it: wanting, looking forward to, enjoying or praising something is positive; letdowns, sighs, sadness, envy, critical digs or insults are negative. News of clear success (wins, records, awards) is positive; news of clear harm (injury, death, crash, charge, delay) is negative. Choose neutral for plain information, ads, listings, stats, matter-of-fact activity reports, 'who's going?' questions, playful banter, armchair opinions about players or politicians, and mock-dramatic overreactions to trivial things.

neutral.what: No noticeable lean: plain information, ads, schedules, stats, headlines without clear outcome, questions, flat activity reports, banter, armchair opinions, and joking overreactions to trivial things.
examples: Anyone wanna buy a Zac Brown Band ticket for the 3rd?
Might just watch the 3rd season of American Horror Story tonight
date: august 11th still no sign of frank ocean's new album. the world is turning on itself. buildings are burning. god refuses to comment.
Ebola nurse may have been sick before taking the plane
neutral.cues: selling, tickets, scheduled, reportedly, 'may' speculation, stats, dates, might, who's going, lol
neutral.not_for: Personal tweets with a noticeable pleasant lean (positive) or a real letdown, sigh or insult (negative).

positive.what: Noticeable pleasant lean: anticipation of plans or treats, enjoyment, liking, praise, pride, affection, tributes, or news of a clear success.
examples: I want IHOP tomorrow morning
8th strikeout of the afternoon for David Price's 100th career win!
Sending my sincere prayers & condolences to the Gifford family on Frank Gifford's passing. May he rest in peace.
positive.cues: want, can't wait, love, glad, fun, excited, proud, wins, beats, honored, !
positive.not_for: Dry ads, listings, flat activity reports and 'who's going?' questions (neutral).

negative.what: Noticeable unpleasant lean: real letdowns, frustration, sadness, envy, insults, fear, or news of clear harm or failure.
examples: Might not be able to get a free taco tomorrow. As Napoleon Dynamite would say, dang it!
Just remembered I'm taking the PSSAs tomorrow. #Fml
RT @user Gavin Henson looks set to miss the Rugby World Cup after dislocating a bone in his right wrist yesterday
negative.cues: dang it, Argh, why oh why, sad, not happy, worst, sucks, hate, #Fml, injured, delayed
negative.not_for: Flat reports with no bad outcome, teasing, or mock-dramatic jokes (neutral); warm tributes (positive).
